text_zh: 故宫博物院常规散客参观需提前订票，最早可在参观7日前开始预订；通常周一闭馆，法定节假日除外。7天是可预订窗口，不是最少提前天数。年票、团体、专题开放日和临时停展另查。
text_en: Regular individual visits to the Palace Museum require advance ticket booking. Booking opens up to seven days ahead; this is a maximum window, not a seven-day minimum. Mondays are normally closed except statutory public holidays. Annual passes, groups, themed opening days and temporary gallery closures have separate arrangements.

text_zh: 西安碑林博物馆常规散客需实名预约购票，最多可提前5天；官网参观指南列明周一至周日正常开放，没有常规每周闭馆日。5天不是最少提前要求；临时公告和特殊参观另核，证件支持按官方渠道办理。
text_en: Regular individual admission to Xi'an Beilin Museum requires real-name ticket booking, available up to five days ahead. Its visitor guide lists opening Monday through Sunday, with no regular weekly closure. Five days is not a minimum lead time. Check temporary notices, special visits and supported identity documents through official channels.

text_zh: 成都博物馆常规周一闭馆，法定节假日除外。馆方以线上预约为主要入馆方式，并为免预约人群、部分境外观众等提供人工窗口换票和咨询协助；不要把这项协助理解为所有外国游客均可免预约。各人群的强制预约条件与提前窗口本条未核定，行前查官方平台或咨询馆方；临展和活动另查。
text_en: Chengdu Museum normally closes on Mondays except statutory public holidays. Online reservation is its main entry method; service windows assist exempt visitors and some international visitors with ticket exchange or enquiries. This does not establish an exemption for every foreign visitor. Mandatory booking conditions for each visitor category and the advance window are unconfirmed here; consult the official platform or museum before visiting. Exhibitions and events may differ.

subject.name_en: Chengdu Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum

text_zh: 杜甫草堂博物馆官方参观页提供实名预约购票，最多提前14天。14天是可购票窗口，不是必须提前14天；本条未核定普通散客是否必须提前预约或有无固定每周闭馆日，应另查馆方最新说明。学生集体免费参观的提前5个工作日规则不适用于普通散客。
text_en: The Du Fu Thatched Cottage Museum visitor page offers real-name ticket booking up to 14 days ahead. This is a maximum booking window, not a 14-day minimum. This entry does not confirm mandatory advance booking or fixed weekly closing days for ordinary individual visitors; check current museum guidance. The separate five-working-day rule for free student-group visits does not apply to ordinary individuals.

subject.name_zh: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
subject.name_en: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding

text_zh: 成都熊猫基地不享受免票、免预约或特殊办理优待的普通散客须线上实名预约购票，可选最多提前14天的票；到场使用与订单一致的有效证件核验，护照在支持证件范围内。优待人群及无法线上支付等情况另查官方说明。本条未核定每周闭园日，不以季节时刻表推定全年无休；熊猫谷和园内单独场馆不在本条范围。
text_en: Ordinary individual visitors to Chengdu Panda Base who do not qualify for free entry, reservation exemptions or special handling must book real-name tickets online, up to 14 days ahead. Present the matching valid identity document; passports are supported. Consult official rules for concessions and difficulties paying online. Weekly closing days remain unconfirmed here; seasonal hours alone do not prove year-round opening. Panda Valley and individual facilities have separate rules.

text_zh: 秦始皇帝陵博物院对所有观众实行实名线上预约购票，外籍观众和政策性免票人员也须通过官方渠道预约；到场须用与票务信息一致的有效证件原件核验，支持护照。本条未核定提前预约窗口和固定每周闭馆日，重大节假日安排应查新公告。适用兵马俑馆及丽山园的常规参观，不代表实时余票或已完成预约。
text_en: Emperor Qinshihuang's Mausoleum Site Museum requires real-name online ticket reservations for all visitors, including international visitors and people entitled to free admission. Use official channels and bring the matching original valid identity document; passports are accepted. The advance window and fixed weekly closing days are unconfirmed here; check new notices for major-holiday arrangements. This covers ordinary visits to the Terracotta Warriors Museum and Lishan Garden, not live availability or a completed reservation.

subject.name_zh: 八达岭长城（日间常规游览）

text_zh: 八达岭长城日间常规游览提供实名预约购票及现场购票，不强制所有散客提前预订；官网游览须知列明每日开放，没有固定每周闭园日。现场购票不保证有票或即时入园，护照持有者应使用官方购票及核验渠道。恶劣天气可能临时或局部关闭，应查当日公告。夜长城、中国长城博物馆和其他长城景区不套用本条。
text_en: Ordinary daytime visits to Badaling Great Wall offer both real-name advance booking and on-site ticket purchase, so advance booking is not mandatory for every individual visitor. The official visitor guide specifies daily opening, without a regular weekly closure. On-site purchase does not guarantee availability or immediate entry; passport holders should use official ticket and identity-check channels. Severe weather can cause temporary or partial closures. Night tours, the China Great Wall Museum and other Great Wall sites have separate rules.
